hero.description: I am an Industrial Electronics Technician who creates innovative IoT solutions and embedded systems. Turning ideas into reality through code and electronics circuits.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Industrial Electronics Engineering
about.description1: I am a top graduate of Industrial Electronics Engineering with a great interest in developing Internet of Things (IoT) systems, embedded systems, and microcontroller-based automation.
about.description2: My main expertise includes firmware development for microcontrollers such as Arduino and ESP32, electronic circuit design, and sensor and actuator integration for various IoT projects and automation systems.
about.description3: I believe that embedded systems and IoT technology have great potential in helping daily life and modern industry, and I continue to develop my skills in technology and electronic innovation.
about.specializationValue: Internet of Things (IoT), Embedded System, Arduino & ESP32
